column1: # Read by rl_line_blocks in bin/lib/review-level.sh. Tab-separated:
# class, ere, note. A finding line STANDS as a BLOCK when its tag names a class
# in column 1 (`[BLOCK tenant-leak]`) OR its text matches the class's ERE
# (grep -iE, so a model that forgot the tag on a real leak still blocks).
# Anything else tagged BLOCK/HIGH/MEDIUM is demoted to a NOTE by rl_cap.
# Lines that start with # are comments. Edit this file, not the regexes in code.
